Rogue.description: Cunning survivor of the shadows. Master of stealth, deception, precise strikes and survival in the underbelly of the world.
Rogue.lore: In a world ruled by steel and faith, the Rogue survives by never being seen until it is too late. Some are cutthroats and thieves, others silver-tongued spies or charming seducers. They are the knife in the dark, the whispered secret, the smile that hides the dagger.

Assassin.mastery_bonus: backstab damage +3, stealth attack crit chance +15%

Duelist.mastery_bonus: dual wield stamina cost -1, riposte damage +4

Infiltrator.mastery_bonus: stealth in crowds +20%, disguise duration +50%, detection chance -25%

Backstab.effect: If hidden or behind target: +50% damage (stealth bonus +30% in Infiltrator path)

Stealth.effect: +15 to hide in shadows or crowds (Infiltrator: +25)

Silent_Movement.effect: No sound while moving at half speed

Evasion.effect: Once per round, reroll a failed dodge or stealth check

Poison_Use.effect: Apply poison without risk of self-poison

Silent_Kill.effect: Backstab that can instantly kill low-HP targets if undetected

Death_Mark.effect: Next attack on marked target is automatic crit

Master_Pickpocket.effect: Steal equipped items in combat (Infiltrator: +25% success)

Trap_Disarm.effect: Disarm mechanical or magical traps safely

Seductive_Gaze.effect: Charm or distract target (female bonus: +20% success vs males)

Twin_Blade_Dance.effect: Two attacks in one turn with dual wield

Disguise.effect: Impersonate NPCs for extended periods (Infiltrator: +40% duration)

Quiet_Vault.effect: Vault over obstacles while remaining hidden

Assassins_Strike.effect: Stealth attack deals +80% damage and ignores 50% armor

Distraction.effect: Create a distraction to lower enemy detection by 30%

Master_of_Shadows.effect: Stealth checks automatically succeed in good conditions (shadows, crowds, night)

Wanted.effect: Higher chance of being recognized in cities
